text.p: Grocery retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Monday it planned to expand its wholesaling operations through its Australian Independent Wholesalers Pty Ltd (AIW) unit.
Woolworths acquired AIW in July last year as part of its purchase of the Cannons group of stores.
Woolworths said that after the acquisition, inquiries and research revealed that an opportunity did exist for another significant wholesaler in Australia.
The initial development would take place in Queensland and New South Wales and negotations were under way for further expansion.
Woolworths also released its half year results, which showed net profit rose 8.6 percent to A$147.5 million in the 28 weeks to January 5.

"This profit result and continued development of new initiatives demonstrates Woolworths' commitment to growth in the domestic market, providing significant employment opportunities," the company said.
Woolworths said the company had advised the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission of its expansion plans for the AIW operation.
